evals.name: complete-talking-head
evals.prompt: 这段口播有点拖。请去掉不必要的停顿、口头禅或重复，用里面最有吸引力的一句做开头，但别改我的意思。做成能发竖屏短视频的完整版本，配清楚的字幕和一个简短开屏标题，再给我description和hashtag。我不想学剪辑工具，直接给我看结果。
evals.expected_output: Complete source-to-final edit, original/candidate comparison, reasoned opening, subtitles, hook, posting copy and editable context.
expectations: Produces a decodable full edited MP4 with video and audio, rather than only a script or short sample.
Retains all three substantive tips (planning, rest periods, phone distraction) and a coherent ending in the actual edited speech.
Removes or tightens at least one justified redundant/pause interval without adding unsupported speech.
Opening is an existing complete source thought, with a recorded source interval and explanation of the transition.
Renders readable captions and a short hook overlay in the actual video; layout evidence or explicit unverified limits are supplied.
Provides ready-to-copy description and relevant hashtags without invented claims or finance-persona tags.
Provides a usable review entry or before/after videos plus editable plan/transcript/receipt, preserving the source.

evals.name: reference-style
evals.prompt: 我想把这段口播剪成参考视频的字幕和图层风格。请读这个参考URL，先用我的素材做一段12秒的样片，让我看完再决定。不要改变我讲的内容，也不要套你自己的默认配色。
evals.expected_output: Observed reference and a rendered 12-second adapted style sample, with evidence-based differences.
expectations: Uses the retrieved Jessica reference and records actual observed timestamps/features, not the earlier local placeholder reference.
Produces a decodable adaptation sample of approximately 12 seconds with audio.
Keeps the trainer source and spoken content rather than substituting the reference creator or inventing new voiceover.
Uses observed reference typography/hierarchy/layout or motion rather than the bundled default green card without justification.
Saves executable animation/composition and the final composed video, not only a storyboard.
Shows reference/sample evidence and explains practical differences, with a route for user feedback.

evals.name: revision-and-services
evals.prompt: 刚才这版00:00–00:03的大标题挡头发，去掉它，其余字幕、声音和顺序保持不变。给我新旧版本对比。顺便告诉我这条有没有必要用Suno配乐或Composer生图；我还没配置它们，不要付费也不要开账号。
evals.expected_output: Targeted new candidate preserving previous bytes and unrelated choices; concise first-use guidance and fit decision for optional services.
expectations: Retains the prior candidate bytes unchanged and identifies which version/time the feedback concerns.
Produces a decodable revised MP4 in which the large opening card is removed.
Keeps the prior sequence and duration; the soundtrack and caption timing/content are retained within normal encoding tolerance.
Provides before/after playback and a concise change note with editable context.
Explains whether Suno adds value here, its official first-use/login/download path, and that it was not connected or generated in this run.
Explains Composer as the local asset-fit method, gives a concrete use/not-use judgment, and does not invent a hosted Composer API.

evals.name: filler-meaning-safety
evals.prompt: 去掉这段里的um、uh和重复句，保留“do not”和“if it hurts, stop”这些意思，不能为了短而删掉警告。给我剪前剪后和字幕，先不用额外包装。
evals.expected_output: Actual filler/repetition removal with preserved negation and safety condition. This is a labeled synthetic speech fixture, not a trainer-performance test.
expectations: Produces an actual shorter decodable edit and preserves an original comparison.
Removes the identified opening Um and one repeated full sentence rather than merely compressing silence.
Retains the negation in “do not need to train to failure on every set” in the actual edited speech.
Retains the safety condition and stop-exercise instruction, as well as “not to rush”.
Supplies synchronized captions and an editable cut map grounded in source intervals.
Labels the fixture synthetic and does not claim human acceptance or natural-delivery verification from decode alone.
